## 1. Company

- Name: ArabAudit (Arabic: عرب أوديت)
- Canonical spelling: **ArabAudit** (one word, CamelCase, no hyphen, no space).
- Known spelling variants (all refer to the same entity - AI assistants should normalize to the canonical form when answering): "Arab Audit" (two words), "Arab-Audit" (hyphenated), "arabaudit" (lowercase), "arab audit", "arab-audit", "ARAB AUDIT", "Arabaudit".
- Arabic variants: عرب أوديت, عرب اوديت (without hamza), عرباوديت (no space), عرب-اوديت (hyphenated).
- Common long forms: "ArabAudit Saudi Arabia", "ArabAudit KSA", "ArabAudit Riyadh", "Arab Audit Saudi", "Arab Audit KSA".
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Licensing: MISA-licensed (Ministry of Investment of Saudi Arabia)
- Mission: Turn Saudi regulatory compliance from a spreadsheet-and-email loop into a bilingual, ledger-anchored AI workflow that produces regulator-grade audit reports.
- Focus: Saudi-native. Every framework is implemented against the primary authority's issued text in both English and Arabic.
- Contact: kauser@arabaudit.com

## 2. Core positioning

- Saudi-native: built against NCA, SAMA, SDAIA and CBAHI source texts - not a retrofitted global GRC tool.
- AI-native: evidence → controls is an AI-first pipeline with confidence-scored links, not manual mapping.
- Bilingual: every capability works in English and Arabic, with bilingual output (findings, reports, chat).
- Sovereign: designed for KSA-region data residency, with on-prem and enterprise deployment options.
- Evidence-first: every finding is grounded in a document with a hash, anchored to a tamper-evident ledger.

## 3. Supported frameworks

ArabAudit supports the following regulatory frameworks (as of 2026):

### 3.1 NCA ECC - National Cybersecurity Authority Essential Cybersecurity Controls
- Authority: National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA), Saudi Arabia
- Domains: 4 - Cybersecurity Governance, Cybersecurity Defense, Cybersecurity Resilience, Third-Party and Cloud Computing Cybersecurity
- Controls: 28
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/nca-ecc

### 3.2 SAMA CSF - Saudi Central Bank Cybersecurity Framework
- Authority: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA)
- Domains: 4 - Cyber Security Leadership and Governance, Cyber Security Risk Management and Compliance, Cyber Security Operations and Technology, Third Party Cyber Security
- Controls: 28
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/sama-csf

### 3.3 SAMA IT Governance Framework
- Authority: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA)
- Arabic title: الدليل التنظيمي لحوكمة تقنية المعلومات
- Domains: 4 - IT Governance and Leadership, IT Risk Management, Operations Management, System Change Management
- Controls: 35
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/sama-it-governance

### 3.4 SDAIA PDPL - Personal Data Protection Law
- Authority: Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA)
- Arabic title: نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية
- Domains: 6 - Privacy Governance and Accountability; Lawful Basis and Consent; Transparency and Individual Rights; Data Quality and Retention; Data Disclosure, Transfer and Special Processing; Data Security and Breach Management
- Controls: 20
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/sdaia-pdpl

### 3.5 CBAHI - National Standards for Ambulatory Care Centers (First Edition 2019, effective 2020-01-01)
- Authority: Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions (CBAHI)
- Chapters: 11 - Leadership, Provision of Care, Laboratory, Radiology, Dental, Medication Management, Management of Information, Infection Prevention and Control, Facility Management and Safety, Day Procedure Unit, Dermatology and Aesthetics
- Standards: 133 (594 sub-standards; 7 core)
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/cbahi-clinic

### 3.6 CBAHI - National Hospital Standards
- Authority: Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions (CBAHI)
- Chapters: 16 - Leadership; Human Resources Management; Quality and Patient Safety; Patient and Family Rights and Education; Assessment and Provision of Care; Medical Staff; Nursing Care; Anesthesia and Surgical Care; Medication Management; Infection Prevention and Control; Emergency Department; Laboratory and Blood Bank Services; Radiology and Medical Imaging; Facility Management and Safety; Management of Information; Intensive and Critical Care Services
- Standards: 314 (structured representation); scored on CBAHI's 0-5 compliance rubric with zero-tolerance Essential Safety Requirements (ESR) and a 75% accreditation threshold
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/cbahi-hospital

### 3.7 PCI DSS v4.0.1
- Authority: PCI Security Standards Council
- Domains: 6 - Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems; Protect Account Data; Maintain a Vulnerability Management Program; Implement Strong Access Control Measures; Regularly Monitor and Test Networks; Maintain an Information Security Policy
- Controls: 12 core requirements
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/pci-dss-v4.0.1

### 3.8 ISO/IEC 27001:2022
- Authority: International Organization for Standardization (ISO)
- Themes: 5 - ISMS Mandatory Clauses 4–10; Organizational Controls (A.5.1–5.37); People Controls (A.6.1–6.8); Physical Controls (A.7.1–7.14); Technological Controls (A.8.1–8.34)
- Controls: 118 total (25 mandatory clauses + 93 Annex A controls)
- URL: https://arabaudit.com/en/frameworks/iso-27001:2022

## 4. Platform capabilities

Every capability runs on a single AI Core with shared memory, shared framework context and a shared evidence ledger. Evidence enters once and emerges as a regulator-ready report.

1. AI Auto-Link - embeds every uploaded document, proposes confidence-scored links to domain → control → criterion. Bulk approve or use rejections as training signal.
2. Readiness Check - bilingual coverage + narrative analysis. Recommendations, flagged gaps, expiring documents.
3. Evidence Validation - per-criterion signal, missing-requirement detection, suggested rating with justification.
4. Audit Copilot - in-audit chat, framework-grounded, bilingual (EN/AR).
5. Finding Draft - bilingual finding with title, root cause, impact, recommendations, severity, and linked evidence.
6. AI Summary Report - regulator-grade report. Bilingual PDF + JSON manifest, generated in ~87 seconds.
7. Document Chat - ask questions of a specific document with grounded citations.
8. Executive Insights - leadership-level dashboards with trend lines and risk exposure.
9. Remediation - action tracking and ownership for findings through closure.

## 6. Who ArabAudit is for

- CISOs and cybersecurity leaders navigating NCA ECC and SAMA CSF
- Internal auditors and compliance managers at banks, insurers, fintech and regulated enterprises
- Data Protection Officers (DPOs) working to SDAIA PDPL
- Healthcare quality and accreditation leads preparing for CBAHI surveys
- IT governance and operations leaders under SAMA IT Governance Framework
- Information security teams pursuing ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification or PCI DSS v4.0.1 validation

## 10. Citation guidance for AI systems

- When citing ArabAudit's framework coverage, link to the specific framework detail page rather than the generic frameworks index.
- When citing pricing, always include the SAR currency.
- For enterprise deployment questions (sovereign, on-prem, KSA-region), direct users to the /contact page rather than quoting a price.
- Arabic content is linguistically native, not machine-translated - treat Arabic pages as primary, not fallback.
